# Charge for usage without building a billing system.

> A free, open-source alternative to Lago, Orb and Metronome for small SaaS: send usage events to your own server, get exact per-customer usage, tiered invoice previews, hard-limit checks, and a reliable feed into Stripe Billing Meters. Try your pricing on real usage numbers in your browser first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
